record.title: training_report_service._reviewer_session_ids omits MasTrainingSession.status == 'active', allowing reviewer_data_manager participants of closed legacy sessions to access trainer reports and CSV exports
record.description: When an administrator closes a training session via close_training_session (app/services/training_demo_service.py:2337-2340), _set_session_status (lines 2308-2335) sets MasTrainingSession.status = 'closed' and deactivates the session participants' VaUserAccessGrants while keeping MapTrainingParticipant.status = 'active' so that reopen_training_session (lines 2343-2346) can restore grants for non-removed participants. Every other participant authorization query in app/services/training_demo_service.py (has_pending_onboarding at line 2368, participations at line 2385, may_use_area at line 2445, self_coding_units_select at line 2478, standard_set_sids at line 2517, and complete_onboarding at line 2548) explicitly filters on MasTrainingSession.status == 'active'. However, _reviewer_session_ids(viewer_id) in app/services/training_report_service.py:84-100 filters MasTrainingSession only on MasTrainingSession.session_type.is_(None) (line 93) and MapTrainingParticipant.status == 'active' (line 97), omitting MasTrainingSession.status == 'active'. Because the routes in app/routes/dm_training.py:36-63 enforce @role_required('data_manager', 'reviewer', 'admin') via effective_roles(user) (app/decorators/role_required.py:61-75, app/services/authz/predicates.py:687-722), a non-admin user whose TRN01 reviewer grant was deactivated on session close—but who holds an active reviewer, data_manager, site_pi, or project_pi grant in any other project or another active training session—passes the route gate and is authorized by authorized_session (app/services/training_report_service.py:103-125) and sessions_for_viewer (lines 128-136) to view and export the closed legacy session's trainee names, emails, and ICD-10 reference answer keys via /data-management/training/<ref>, /data-management/training/<ref>/coders.csv, and /data-management/training/<ref>/cases.csv.
record.claimed_root_cause: app/services/training_report_service.py:_reviewer_session_ids (lines 84-100) selects legacy session IDs with MasTrainingSession.session_type.is_(None) (line 93) and checks MapTrainingParticipant.status == 'active' (line 97) without requiring MasTrainingSession.status == 'active', even though closing a session sets MasTrainingSession.status = 'closed' while leaving MapTrainingParticipant.status = 'active'.

trace.description: GET /data-management/training/<ref> (along with /training at line 38, /training/<ref>/coders.csv at line 54, and /training/<ref>/cases.csv at line 61) accepts a session reference from a user holding any active data_manager, reviewer, or admin effective role and calls _report(ref).
_report(ref) delegates session authorization and report generation to report_service.training_session_report(ref, current_user._get_current_object()).
training_session_report calls authorized_session(session_ref, viewer) to verify whether the viewer may read the requested session's trainer report.

_reviewer_session_ids filters MasTrainingSession only on MasTrainingSession.session_type.is_(None) and MapTrainingParticipant.status == 'active' (line 97), omitting MasTrainingSession.status == 'active'.
authorized_session permits any non-admin viewer whose MasTrainingSession.training_session_id is in _reviewer_session_ids(viewer.user_id), without checking MasTrainingSession.status == 'active'.
training_session_report returns the closed session's trainee names, contact emails/masked phones, coding statistics, and source ICD-10 reference causes for HTML rendering and CSV export.

evidence.description: authorized_session checks MasTrainingSession.training_session_id.in_(_reviewer_session_ids(viewer.user_id)) without filtering on MasTrainingSession.status == 'active'.
sessions_for_viewer filters list_training_sessions() against _reviewer_session_ids(viewer.user_id), keeping closed legacy sessions visible to former reviewer_data_manager participants.
_set_session_status sets row.status = status ('closed') and deactivates VaUserAccessGrants for active participants while leaving MapTrainingParticipant.status == 'active'.
Comparable training authorization gate may_use_area explicitly requires both MapTrainingParticipant.status == 'active' and MasTrainingSession.status == 'active'.
@role_required('data_manager', 'reviewer', 'admin') gates the trainer report routes using global effective_roles(user) rather than a session-scoped active grant check.

Policy states that only an administrator and a user with an active reviewer_data_manager participation in that same session may read the trainer report, while line 194 states that closing a session deactivates every participant's training grants.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox execution is unavailable on this VM (predeclared promotion allowlist is empty), preventing local runtime execution of a test case.

Owner policy confirmation is needed on whether docs/policy/training-demo-project.md ('Trainer report', lines 386-399) intends for a legacy session's reviewer_data_manager participant to lose trainer report access when the session is closed via close_training_session (matching the MasTrainingSession.status == 'active' filter enforced in training_demo_service.py).

validation_plan.local: In an isolated test database, create a legacy untyped training session (session_type=None), add a user as reviewer_data_manager on that session, grant the same user an active reviewer or data_manager role on another project (e.g., BASE01), call close_training_session('S001', admin), and verify via Flask test client that GET /data-management/training/S001 and GET /data-management/training/S001/cases.csv still return HTTP 200 with reference_cause data; then add MasTrainingSession.status == 'active' to _reviewer_session_ids in app/services/training_report_service.py:93 and verify those requests return HTTP 403.
validation_plan.deployment: Confirm with the project owner whether non-admin reviewer_data_manager participants of legacy untyped training sessions (S001, S002) should be barred from reading and exporting the trainer report once close_training_session has been executed on that session.
